title: personal-llm-mini-tracker-maya-2026-q2
content:
Personal LLM inference mini-tracker (Q2 2026) - notes & quick metrics
Owner: Maya Chen
Purpose: quick daily tracking of small inference experiments — latency vs throughput vs quality tradeoffs. Mostly rough notes; use before formalizing into perf-report.

Columns: date | model | quant | batch | seq_len | p50_ms | p95_ms | tok/s | notes | status

Rows:
2026-02-12 | Llama2-13B | fp16  | 1  | 128 | 45  | 110 | 1200 | baseline on dedicated-small, no KV cache. replies ok | done
2026-02-17 | Llama2-13B | int8  | 1  | 128 | 35  | 95  | 1600 | int8 + kernel opt, slight drop in coherence on long prompts | in_progress
2026-02-20 | Redw-v1-7B  | q4_0  | 4  | 64  | 22  | 60  | 2400 | batching4 improved throughput, p95 spiked on cold cache | done
2026-02-25 | Llama2-13B | int8  | 8  | 64  | 60  | 210 | 3800 | batching8 amplifies tail latency; need async KV prefetch | draft
2026-02-28 | Redw-v1-7B  | fp16  | 2  | 256 | 33  | 80  | 1800 | long context (256) pushes mem; consider quant profile | done

Notes:
- p50/p95 measured with local loadgen (simple single-worker). Need to run distributed load tests for final numbers.
- 'tok/s' = tokens generated per second measured end-to-end (app + runtime)
- Quality checks done via small eval set (5 prompts), subjective pass/fail noted in 'notes'. Archive evals in /confluence/EVALS-2026.

To-dos & next steps:
- Re-run Llama2-13B int8 with KV caching warm (ticket JIRA-INF-721). Check p95 impact. (owner: Maya)
- Try async KV prefetch prototype from https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 against batching=8
- Add prompt set for hallucination/regression check and compute simple BLEU/ROUGE per run
- Consolidate results into perf-report draft by 2026-03-10

Quick spot observations:
- int8 reduces p50 substantially but increases p95 in batched/high-concurrency scenarios
- batching helps tok/s but tail latency mitigation needed (prefetch + separate tail buffer)
- Redw-v1-7B shows best cost/throughput for short chat flows

Scratch notes:
- Consider adding 'warm_kv=true' toggle to experiments table
- Keep small JSON export format: date,model,quant,batch,seq,p50,p95,tok_s,notes,status
